description.value: Double Double is a Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant in Richmond specializing in the 'back alley faves' of Hong Kong and Chiu Chow cuisine. The menu draws on traditional street-food staples — hand-pulled oil donuts (油條), hand-made steamed rice rolls, ChiuChow congee, and wok-fried noodles — prepared with what the owners describe as time-honored techniques. It occupies a unit in the 4600 No.3 Road retail complex, a busy commercial corridor in central Richmond.
